metrics.name: purchase_return_header_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.business_documents WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PRLedger'

metrics.name: purchase_return_line_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PRdetail'

metrics.name: purchase_return_total
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM public.business_documents WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PRLedger'

metrics.name: purchase_return_line_quantity
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(PackQty AS decimal(19,4)) * CASE WHEN PackUnits = 0 THEN 1 ELSE PackUnits END + CAST(LooseQty AS decimal(19,4))), 0) FROM dbo.PRdetail
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PRdetail'
